inputs.label: Your MechAssault 2 disc image (.iso or .xiso) from the US (NTSC) disc, or a folder copied from that disc.

prepare.label: Building the game from your disc (about 15 to 30 minutes)

options.label: Microsoft C++ Build Tools
options.note: Needed to build the game on your PC. Installed if this PC doesn't have them.

options.label: Download FFmpeg
options.note: Plays the cutscenes. Downloaded from gyan.dev during the build and checked file by file.

options.label: Enhanced textures 2x (AI upscaled, recommended)
options.note: Makes the 'Mechs look much sharper. Environments improve more subtly. Textures are upscaled by AI on your graphics card during setup, which takes a few hours and adds about 0.6 GB, and you can't play until it finishes. Many players start without it and add it later with Set Up Again.

options.label: Enhanced textures 4x (AI upscaled)
options.note: Even sharper than 2x, for large or high-resolution screens. Takes several hours and adds about 2.2 GB, and you can't play until it finishes.

options.label: Enhanced cutscenes (AI upscaled)
options.note: Slightly sharper pre-rendered movies. A small difference for a long wait: many hours, adds 3.5 GB and needs 25 GB free while it runs. You can add it later with Set Up Again.

options.label: PLACEHOLDER: Show the installer window
options.note: PLACEHOLDER: Setup opens the MechAssault 2 installer's own window in this folder, to choose its options yourself, repair the game or collect diagnostics. Close it when it says Ready to play.

settings.label: Window mode
settings.help: Full screen fills your screen without a border. F11 also switches in the game.

settings.label: Picture shape
settings.help: Widescreen shows more to the sides on wide screens. Original keeps the Xbox's 4:3 picture with side bars.

settings.label: Frame rate limit
settings.help: The most frames per second the game draws. Cutscenes keep their own limit.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Matches frames to your screen to stop tearing. Adds a little input delay.

settings.label: Draw distance
settings.help: How far you can see. Original is the Xbox's distance; Far shows twice as far.

settings.label: Show frame rate
settings.help: Shows the frames per second in a corner of the screen.

exit_codes.3: MechAssault 2 stopped after a crash or a hang. A report was saved in its Logs folder.
